::: {#thm-anova-null}
#### Null distribution of the ANOVA F statistic

Let all $n$ observations be independent,
with observation $y_{ji}$ Gaussian with mean $\mu_j$
and the same variance $\sigma^2$ in every group.
If $H_0: \mu_1 = \cdots = \mu_k$ holds,
then $F$ (@def-one-way-anova), computed from these random variables,
has the $F_{k-1,\, n-k}$ distribution [@hoggtanis2015, Section 9.3, p. 449].
:::
